notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich had died this turn.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ebondeath, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {4}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.
